cleaner.label: OpenCode (AI)
cleaner.description: Cache, logs and archives of old sessions. OpenCode V2 uses SQLite.

option.label: Package and model cache
option.description: Deletes OpenCode's global cache, including downloaded dependencies that will be recreated.
option.warning: On restart OpenCode may re-download packages, plugins and managed tools.

option.label: Application logs
option.description: Deletes the logs under OpenCode's data folder.

option.label: V1 / legacy sessions (advanced)
option.description: Deletes the old project folder containing V1 sessions and messages.
option.warning: Deletes the version 1 project data. V2 uses SQLite: do NOT delete opencode.db, as it also holds credentials; use opencode session delete ID.
